name: LILYGO T-Display S3
description: ESP32-S3R8 board with a 1.9-inch 170x320 color LCD, 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, USB-C, LiPo connector and Qwiic port for about $9; best value S3 board with a built-in screen.
notes: 1.9-inch ST7789V 170x320 LCD on an 8-bit parallel bus (fast), backlight and power-enable pins use GPIOs. Two user buttons (BOOT/GPIO0 and GPIO14); battery voltage on GPIO4.

Variants: with/without soldered header pins, with capacitive touch panel (different pin map) and with a plastic shell. JST-GH 1.25 mm 2-pin LiPo connector and JST-SH 1.0 mm 4-pin Qwiic/STEMMA QT port.
Native USB only (no UART bridge): hold BOOT while plugging in if upload fails. GPIO count and board size are approximate (header pins are 2.54 mm; most GPIOs are used by the display).
